lines.text: I'm just going to chill at home today.

data.define: To relax and do nothing special; also used to say someone is easygoing.

example.text: I'm just going to chill at home today.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chill' when someone needs urgent help.
misuse.why: It sounds like you don't care.

publish.title: What does "chill" mean?
publish.value: Chill = Relax and take it easy. Example: "I'm just going to chill at home today." (casual English).
